target_segments: Peripheral sensory neuropathy or peripheral motor neuropathy, either of Grade 2 or higher.

sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: peripheral sensory neuropathy is a distinct screening target from peripheral motor neuropathy. The Grade 2-or-higher qualifier explicitly applies to either branch and is retained with this child (X2).

text_span: peripheral motor neuropathy, either of Grade 2 or higher
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: peripheral motor neuropathy is independently evaluable and separately eligibility-determinative; the shared Grade 2-or-higher qualifier applies to this branch.
